headline: Flat 25% off your first hotel booking (max ₹2500)
description: New Cleartrip customers get flat 25% off their first domestic hotel booking (max 2500 rupees), or 12% off their first international hotel booking (max 3000 rupees).
how_to_redeem:
1. Open cleartrip.com or the Cleartrip app as a new customer.
2. Pick your first hotel.
3. Enter code CTFIRST before payment.
terms: New Cleartrip customers only; first hotel booking only.

headline: Flat 10% off your first bus booking (up to ₹150)
description: Flat 10% off (up to 150 rupees) on your first bus booking on Goibibo.
how_to_redeem:
1. Search buses on Goibibo.
2. Apply code WELCOME at checkout.
3. Complete your first bus booking.
terms: First bus booking on Goibibo only.

headline: Up to 12% off domestic flights with HDFC Bank EasyEMI (max ₹2000)
description: Up to 12% off domestic flights (max 2000 rupees, min booking 5000 rupees) with HDFC Bank credit card EasyEMI, plus an extra 300 rupees off on 6- or 9-month EMI.
how_to_redeem:
1. Book a domestic flight on Goibibo.
2. Apply code HDFCEMI.
3. Pay with HDFC Bank credit card EasyEMI.
terms: HDFC Bank credit card EasyEMI only; min booking 5000 rupees; one booking per card per month; not on commercial/NR cards, net banking or card via UPI; no clubbing.

headline: Up to 10% off international flights with HDFC Bank EasyEMI (max ₹7500)
description: Up to 10% off international flights (max 7500 rupees, min booking 10000 rupees) with HDFC Bank credit card EasyEMI, plus an extra 1500 rupees off on 6- or 9-month EMI.
how_to_redeem:
1. Book an international flight on Goibibo.
2. Apply code HDFCINTEMI.
3. Pay with HDFC Bank credit card EasyEMI.
terms: HDFC Bank credit card EasyEMI only; min booking 10000 rupees; one booking per card per month; not on commercial/NR cards, net banking or card via UPI; no clubbing.

headline: 15% off your first bus booking (up to ₹250)
description: New ixigo users get 15% instant discount (up to 250 rupees) plus 15% cashback (up to 250 rupees) on their first bus booking.
how_to_redeem:
1. Open ixigo as a new user.
2. Choose your bus.
3. Apply code IX15 at checkout.
terms: New ixigo users; first bus booking only.
verified_note: ✓ Official ixigo bus offers page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: Flat 50% off hotels with HDFC Bank Mastercard debit cards (up to ₹500)
description: Flat 50% off hotel bookings (up to 500 rupees) with HDFC Bank Mastercard debit cards. Pay Now bookings only.
how_to_redeem:
1. Log in to ixigo and pick a hotel.
2. Choose Pay Now.
3. Apply code IXIHDFC3 and pay with an HDFC Bank Mastercard debit card.
terms: New users; Pay Now bookings only; once per user during the offer period.

headline: 20% off your first bus booking (up to ₹200)
description: New users get 20% off (up to 200 rupees) plus 20% cashback (up to 200 rupees) on their first booking; existing users get 8% off plus 8% cashback (each up to 200 rupees). For journeys 8–25 Oct 2026.
how_to_redeem:
1. Log in to AbhiBus.
2. Book a private bus for a journey between 8 and 25 Oct 2026 (min 500 rupees).
3. Apply code FESTIVAL at checkout.
terms: Min booking 500 rupees; journey dates 8–25 Oct 2026; private buses only (not government RTCs); login required; once per user; no clubbing.

headline: Flat ₹400–₹3000 off — a different travel deal each day
description: A different flat discount each day of the week on flights, buses, hotels and cabs (for example Monday: 400 rupees off domestic flights over 3000 rupees, 1000 rupees off international flights over 12000 rupees).
how_to_redeem:
1. Open EaseMyTrip.
2. Check that day's deal on the EASEDAY offer page.
3. Apply code EASEDAY at checkout.
terms: New and existing users; once per user per category; minimum booking amounts vary by day.

headline: Up to 60% off weekend hotel stays
description: Up to 60% off hotel stays that fall on a weekend (Friday to Sunday) on EaseMyTrip.
how_to_redeem:
1. Search hotels on EaseMyTrip for a Friday–Sunday stay.
2. Apply code EMTWKND at checkout.
terms: Stay must fall on a weekend (Fri–Sun); discount capped at 60%.

headline: 5% instant discount on flight bookings
description: 5% instant discount on flight bookings on EaseMyTrip for all customers.
how_to_redeem:
1. Search flights on EaseMyTrip.
2. Apply code EMT2026 at checkout.

headline: Up to ₹5000 off overnight hotel stays (Durga Puja)
description: Up to 5000 rupees off overnight hotel stays on Bag2Bag for Durga Puja (the exact discount depends on your membership level).
how_to_redeem:
1. Log in on the Bag2Bag website or app.
2. Book an overnight stay.
3. Apply code PUJOJOY.
terms: Login required; Bag2Bag website or app only; may not combine with other offers.

headline: 25% off up to ₹80 when paying with Paytm UPI
description: 25% off (up to 80 rupees) on Zomato orders above 199 rupees when you pay through a Paytm-linked bank account (UPI).
how_to_redeem:
1. Order on Zomato (min 199 rupees).
2. Apply code UPIBONANZA.
3. Pay with Paytm UPI.
terms: Paytm-linked bank account (UPI) only; min order 199 rupees; once per user per week; applies to your first UPI transaction on Zomato.

headline: 12.5% instant discount with Kotak Bank credit cards (max ₹2500)
description: 12.5% instant discount (max 2500 rupees; min transaction 7500 rupees) with Kotak Bank credit cards on select Tata CLiQ Luxury products.
how_to_redeem:
1. Shop select products on luxury.tatacliq.com or the app (min 7500 rupees).
2. Apply code TCLKOTAK.
3. Pay in full with a Kotak Bank credit card.
terms: Kotak Bank credit cards (full swipe) only; once per card per month; select products.
verified_note: ✓ Official Tata CLiQ Luxury T&C page (checked 6 Oct 2026)

headline: Buy 1 Get 1 free movie & event tickets with select ICICI Bank credit cards (no code)
description: Buy one ticket and get one free on movies and events on BookMyShow with select ICICI Bank credit cards. Limited quota; a processing fee applies.
how_to_redeem:
1. Book at least 2 tickets on BookMyShow (web or app).
2. Choose the ICICI Bank offer at payment.
3. Pay with an eligible ICICI Bank credit card.
terms: Select ICICI Bank credit cards; min 2 tickets; you must have spent 25000 rupees or more on the card in the previous spend quarter; limited quota; processing fee applies.

headline: 25% off movie tickets with select ICICI Bank credit cards (no code)
description: 25% off movie tickets on BookMyShow with select ICICI Bank credit cards. First come first served daily stock; a processing fee applies.
how_to_redeem:
1. Book at least 2 movie tickets on BookMyShow.
2. Choose the ICICI Bank 25% offer at payment.
3. Pay with an eligible ICICI Bank credit card.
terms: Select ICICI Bank credit cards; movies only; min 2 tickets; 25000 rupees+ spend in the previous quarter; daily stock; processing fee applies.

headline: 3 months of Google AI Plus or Pro free with select ASUS & ROG laptops (no code)
description: Buy a select ASUS or ROG laptop and get 3 months of Google One with Google AI Plus (400 GB) or Google AI Pro (5 TB), depending on the model.
how_to_redeem:
1. Check your laptop model is eligible on the ASUS offer page.
2. Redeem the Google One offer from the laptop with your Google account.
terms: Eligible laptop models only; Google account and payment method required; auto-renews at the standard Google One price unless cancelled.
verified_note: ✓ Official ASUS India offer page (checked 6 Oct 2026)
